name: llm_queue_drain_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: LLM_QUEUE_DRAIN_20261103 — the overnight queue requeues failed provider jobs on a growing delay instead of dropping them, gives each exhausted job exactly one deduplicated incident, and makes credit ledger rows name the process that spent them. The requeue rule, the one-incident rule and the emergency cheap-tier caps are config (config/llm_queue_drain.json, config/anthropic_credit_policy.json); the code reads them.
Registered so the gate file set stays complete: tests/test_ci_test_coverage_gate.py refuses a test file that no gate lists (ci_self_guards / shard 7).
